record.dic_text:
3069 Ludda {lud'-dah}

源自希伯來文 SNH03850; 專有地名

欽定本 - Lydda 3; 3

呂大 = "衝突, 爭鬥"

1) 距約帕 (Joppa) 9英里 (15公里) 的一個城市, 位於約帕與耶路撒冷之間最北方,兩條公路上的第一個城市 (#徒 9:32,35,38|)
record.edic_text:
3069 Ludda {lud'-dah}

of Hebrew origin 03850;; n pr loc

AV - Lydda 3; 3

Lydda = "strife"

1) a town is 9 miles (15 km) from Joppa, and is the first town on the
   northernmost of the two roads between that place and Jerusalem
